contentHtml:
Provisioning templates and module usage examples that apply Infrastructure Standards.

Planned Template Families

Directory Purpose
modules/ Reusable infrastructure module boundaries and documented inputs/outputs
environments/ Development, staging and production-oriented composition patterns
topologies/ Provisioning examples tied to an explicit runtime topology

Infrastructure templates must state provider assumptions, state/backend handling, credentials required, cost implications, teardown/recovery behavior and whether they are illustrative or intended as a reusable module baseline.

Terraform-specific additions should follow documented module and examples/ structure expectations from HashiCorp where that tool is chosen.
